universal_lens: Atmospheric conditions modulate NFL offensive efficiency through wind speed and temperature, affecting passing vs. rushing strategies via expected points added (EPA) metrics. Weather-induced tactical adaptation models integrate thermal and aerodynamic constraints into offensive efficiency matrices.
